verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API with an embedded OpenAPI 3.0 spec, resource-oriented JSON:API endpoints, and a claim that it can 'connect to any existing object' in the account. An official MCP server also lets clients query and update controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more. However, nothing states or demonstrates that the API matches the UI, and many UI workflows have no evidenced API equivalent, including Trust Center configuration, policy editing, access-review decisions and request approvals. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented write coverage for all UI workflows (Trust Center, policies, access reviews), and independent or hands-on confirmation of breadth.
